name: Resend
summary: Sends the platform's email through Resend, records its delivery events, and receives the email-in addresses' mail.

capabilities.trigger_rule: A message the outbox holds for sending: one a person or a rule of the platform asked for.
A message Resend received for an email-in address, announced by its signed webhook.

api_base.title: API base
api_base.description: Resend's API base, for fetching received mail.

dns_records.title: DNS records
dns_records.description: The records each sending domain needs for this provider, as its dashboard lists them; the nightly domain check looks for each one.

secrets.name: api_key
secrets.title: API key
secrets.description: A Resend API key that may send and read received email.

secrets.name: webhook_secret
secrets.title: Webhook signing secret
secrets.description: The endpoint's signing secret, which signs Resend's events (Svix).

health_check: Counts Resend's refusals and failed connections in recent sends and fetches.
test_action: Sends one test message to the signed-in person's own verified address and reports whether Resend accepted it.
local_substitute: A fake Resend server in tests; the local stack sends through Mailpit and receives through Mailpit's webhook.
